numinance.kinds.v1.BundleSource.jsonsche.description: BundleSource is one selected source; its content is the artifact with this digest, delivered read-only to the worktree.

access_basis.description: access_basis is required: whose authority the fetch ran under.
access_basis.title: Knowledge Auth

classification.description: classification is the source's data classification as the source system reports it.

digest.description: digest is required: the digest of the redacted content delivered to the executor.

rank.description: rank is the source's position in the selection, from 1.

redactions.description: redactions is the number of secrets and PII spans redacted before persistence.

ref.description: ref is required and unique: the canonical source reference, redacted, since a ref can hold a credential.

selection_reason.description: selection_reason is required: why the resolver selected the source.

source_version.description: source_version is the version or ETag the source reported; absent when it reports none.

system.description: system is required: the KnowledgeConnection name the source was read through.

title.description: title is the source's own title.

trust.description: trust is required and is TRUST_CLASS_UNTRUSTED_RETRIEVED; a decoder refuses any other value.
trust.title: Trust Class

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleSource.jsonsche.title: Bundle Source

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
